name: cockpit
description: Everything for running long sessions in one install: turn-mode, ctx-bar, ctx-heavy, herdr-jump and cache-timer, plus /cockpit:orchestrate, process management for implementation skills: independent lanes run in parallel Herdr tabs (one worktree each) driven from your window, at the fewest tokens and least wall-clock time. Four of the plugins need herdr; cache-timer does not.
